candidates.title: [ux-sim] Sign-up step "What Lumi can do": Continue flips through four sample tabs while the counter stays at 2 of 6
candidates.body:
> **AI simulation — hypotheses, not measured user behaviour.** Curated from AI personas driving a real browser — a hypothesis to confirm with real students, not measured behaviour.

### Problem

Seen on: NEW only. Both sign-up personas pressed Continue on step 2 and landed on another sample tab of the same step, three times, before reaching step 3. Minji (17, impatient with forms) and Marcus (low-tech) each logged it; it added 3 actions to every sign-up.

Severity **2** (Moderate — slowed me down or made me hesitate; I recovered on my own.) · analyst confidence high · **2 simulated persona(s)** across 2 scenario(s).

### Root cause (hypothesis)

/start/what uses the primary Continue button to advance the tab strip (?p=events → clubs → social) instead of the step; the header counter "2 of 6" does not move, so it reads like a stuck button.

### Evidence

- run `cmp2ha-new-cold-start-hangout-minji` step 9 — “뭐지, 계속 눌렀는데 아직 2/6? 탭 4개 다 봐야 돼? 아 귀찮아” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/cmp2ha-new-cold-start-hangout-minji/shots/009-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/cmp2ha-new-cold-start-hangout-minji/shots/009-click-som.jpg)
- run `cmp2ha-new-first-open-decide-marcus` step 10 — “I pressed Continue and it's still '2 of 6'? It just flipped to another sample. How many of these are there?” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/cmp2ha-new-first-open-decide-marcus/shots/010-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/cmp2ha-new-first-open-decide-marcus/shots/010-click-som.jpg)

Runs: [`cmp2ha-new-cold-start-hangout-minji`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/cmp2ha-new-cold-start-hangout-minji/report.md), [`cmp2ha-new-first-open-decide-marcus`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/cmp2ha-new-first-open-decide-marcus/report.md)

### Who

Personas: `minji-freshman-17`, `marcus-senior-lowtech` · scenarios: `cold-start-hangout`, `first-open-decide`

### Suggested fix (hypothesis)

Make Continue go to step 3 from any tab (tabs stay tappable for the curious), or label it "Next sample" and add a visible "Skip preview". Quick fix.

### Note

Severity and persona counts describe simulated personas, not rates of real students. Re-run the affected cells after a fix and compare (docs/ux-sim/ORCHESTRATE.md).

candidates.title: [ux-sim] Club pages still don't say how to join (BASE: Ask to join vs Not recruiting; NEW: "Not taking requests on Lumi")
candidates.body:
> **AI simulation — hypotheses, not measured user behaviour.** Curated from AI personas driving a real browser — a hypothesis to confirm with real students, not measured behaviour.

### Problem

Seen on: BOTH, milder on NEW. BASE: Aisha saw an "Unverified" badge and a big "Ask to join" next to "Not recruiting right now" (sev 3, trust). NEW removes the badge and the contradiction — only "Follow" — but says "Membership: Not taking requests on Lumi · Following never grants private access", which tells her what Lumi doesn't do, not how she can join (sev 2, copy).

Severity **3** (Major — real confusion, a wrong path or many extra steps; I nearly gave up or only got through by guessing.) · analyst confidence high · **1 simulated persona(s)** across 1 scenario(s).

### Root cause (hypothesis)

The club page describes Lumi's membership feature state instead of the club's real joining route (show up / their own form / recruiting season).

### Evidence

- run `cmp2ha-base-find-a-club-aisha` step 4 — “Wait, 'Unverified' — is this even the real club? And 'Ask to join'... who am I asking, does it send my profile?” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/cmp2ha-base-find-a-club-aisha/shots/004-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/cmp2ha-base-find-a-club-aisha/shots/004-click-som.jpg)

candidates.title: [ux-sim] A brand-new account finds nobody: Meetups and People are empty, People says "invite friends"
candidates.body:
> **AI simulation — hypotheses, not measured user behaviour.** Curated from AI personas driving a real browser — a hypothesis to confirm with real students, not measured behaviour.

### Problem

Seen on: BOTH. BASE: Minji signed up, found "No meetups yet" and an empty People list → abandoned (sev 4, "친구가 없어서 깐 건데"). NEW: same empty Meetups and People, but both tabs now list "This week on campus" events with "Go together" underneath, which gave her something to do → goal met (sev 3).

Severity **4** (Blocker — I could not continue, gave up, or would stop using the app here.) · analyst confidence high · **1 simulated persona(s)** across 1 scenario(s).

### Root cause (hypothesis)

Cold start is real (no other students locally or for a new campus); NEW mitigates it by filling the empty state with real campus events.

### Evidence

- run `cmp2ha-base-cold-start-hangout-minji` step 26 _(BASE /meet/meetups: "No meetups yet — create the first meetup")_ [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/cmp2ha-base-cold-start-hangout-minji/shots/026-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/cmp2ha-base-cold-start-hangout-minji/shots/026-click-som.jpg)
